purpose: Ten electricity grid operators' public fuel-mix dashboards for the hero job: public pages only, no login, no paywall. Each entry says which chart the numbers are read from, and where the operator publishes the same mix as data, so the snapshot can show vision's reading beside the published one.

excluded.why: its dashboard sits behind a Cloudflare bot check that a headless browser does not pass
the Current Grid Conditions page carries a status graphic, not a fuel-mix chart
its real-time displays answer 403 to a plain request
the eco2mix page I found answers a soft 404 in a browser
its control-room page shows flows and prices, not a generation mix
the real-time page I tried answered 'page not found'
its charts are Power BI embeds behind a cookie-consent wall; headless Chrome shows an empty frame, so no chart could be read (the old dashboard URL is a 404)
NESO publishes no chart page; the nearest, carbonintensity.org.uk, shows no generation-mix chart in headless Chrome, only a carbon-intensity forecast table
its Current Supply and Demand page is a plain HTML table with no chart, so there is nothing for vision to read
the site answers every request, robots.txt included, with a Cloudflare managed bot check ("Performing security verification")

rules: A page with a bot check, or one that needs more than an ordinary visit and a cookie banner, is excluded; we never work around bot protection.
A site whose robots.txt disallows the dashboard path is excluded.
The agent reads every number from the chart with vision, even where the page prints it as text. The page text or the published data is the check, shown beside the reading.
Each screenshot is cropped to the chart itself, without the operator logo or page chrome.
